summary: Backend: 9/9 pytest cases PASS (test_iter69_self_contact_and_sf_ai.py). Verified (A) auto-creation of idempotent Self contact on POST /api/auth/register — exactly one is_self=true contact, ensure-self is idempotent (no duplicates), session_token still returned. (B1) POST /api/solution-finders/ai/suggest-solutions returns 401 without auth; with the harden_1777921741 user returned 200 with non-empty suggestions echoing only requested rca_ids; empty root_causes returns {suggestions:{}}; never 500. (B2) POST /api/solution-finders/ai/suggest-risks returns 401 without auth; with auth produced 200 with name/impact_pct(0-100)/probability_pct(0-100)/mitigations/contingencies; empty solutions returns {suggestions:{}}; backend logs show the 402 'Payment Required' path was also hit during prior runs (credits wallet metering working). Frontend code-level review confirms: pros-cons-wizard Step 1 no longer renders the Life Area chips picker (only the collapsed summary text uses bLifeArea); solution-finder Q3/Q4 expose purple 'AI auto-fill solutions' and 'AI auto-fill risks, mitigations & contingencies' buttons (rendered only when root causes / solutions exist), with ActivityIndicator spinner, case-insensitive dedup (norm()), append+gaps-only behavior for mitigations/contingencies, and a 402-handler that surfaces an 'Out of AI credits' alert with a 'View wallet' navigation action. Web landing loads without red-screen on 390x844 mobile viewport.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/auth_routes.py: ensure_self_contact_for_user is correctly wrapped in try/except so a self-contact failure does NOT block registration — good defensive coding.

routes/contacts.py:336-340: 'Self' idempotency keyed on (user_id, is_self=True); ensure_self_contact also seeds org_type='individual'/'professional' and tags=['self'] which is reasonable seed metadata.

routes/tools.py:202-373: both AI endpoints (a) gate on ai_metering.has_any_llm() (503 when AI not configured), (b) catch InsufficientCredits -> 402 (not 500), (c) reject bad model JSON with 502, (d) filter output dict to only requested rca_id/sol_id and clamp percentages 0-100 — robust contract.

frontend solution-finder.tsx:333-483: dedup uses case-insensitive norm(); the merge logic correctly appends without overwriting existing entries; for risk matched by name, mitigations/contingencies fill gaps into that existing risk. 402 handler routes to /ai-wallet — matches spec.
frontend pros-cons-wizard.tsx:929-932: explicit code comment confirms the Life Area picker was removed in June 2026; bLifeArea is now only consumed in the read-only collapsed summary line 892.
